title: Extend ONNX Frontend with `BatchNormalization` operators in versions 14 and 15
body:
## Context
Neural networks are graphs consisting of nodes called operators. Each operator corresponds to a mathematical function, usually described in framework's documentation or an AI standard, such as ONNX.

OpenVINO ONNX Frontend is a component responsible for working with ONNX graphs and requires implementation of different ONNX operators in order to use ONNX models.

This task requires extending OpenVINO ONNX Frontend with `BatchNormalization` operator in versions 14 and 15.

Necessary help will be provided by ONNX Fronted team.


## Operator specification
Operator details can be found in [BatchNormalization spec in version 15](https://github.com/onnx/onnx/blob/main/docs/Operators.md#batchnormalization) and [BatchNormalization spec in version 14](https://github.com/onnx/onnx/blob/main/docs/Changelog.md#BatchNormalization-14).


## Todo list
1. In the current moment, we are supporting `BatchNormalization` [in versions 1,7,9](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/src/frontends/onnx/frontend/src/op/batch_norm.cpp) (note, that between versions 7 and 9 there are no differences). Prepare implementation of  versions 14 and 15 in equvalent way (in a separate opset, in form of a function)
2. Register the function in [ops_bridge.cpp](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/src/frontends/onnx/frontend/src/ops_bridge.cpp#L554-L560) while keeping alphabetical order
3. Create test model(s) in [ONNX models directory](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/tree/master/src/frontends/onnx/tests/models). OpenVINO test infrastructure then converts prototxt files to ONNX models - you will use those models later in tests
5. Add tests covering all use cases [here](/home/<user>/openvino/src/frontends/onnx/tests/onnx_import.in.cpp)

More details in [adding operators to ONNX Frontend guide](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/src/frontends/onnx/docs/how_to_add_op.md)


## Resources
- [Contribution guide - start here!](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- Guides on [ONNX Frontend architecture](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/src/frontends/onnx/docs/architecture.md) and [ONNX Frontend tests](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/src/frontends/onnx/docs/tests.md) are also available
- You can also see a [blog post on contributing to OpenVINO](https://medium.com/openvino-toolkit/how-to-contribute-to-an-ai-open-source-project-c741f48e009e)

## Tips
Note, that in version 14 was introduced an attribute `training_mode` to determinne if an op is called in traning or inference mode (instead of basing on outputs number, like in version 9). We are not able now to handle (decompose to OV representation) this op in training mode.

## Example PRs
- https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/pull/15076
- https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/pull/14936
- https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/pull/12510


## Contact points
@reporter
@participant2
Don't hesitate to reach out, we're here to help!

Internal reference: [CVS-114253](https://<redacted-host>/browse/CVS-114253)
